_about: J. H. Merle d'Aubigné (1794-1872), Genevan church historian of the Réveil: History of the Reformation of the Sixteenth Century, in H. White's translation revised by the author (New York: American Tract Society, undated, 5 vols), and History of the Reformation in Europe in the Time of Calvin (London: Longmans, 1863-1878, 8 vols; vols 6-8 name W. L. R. Cates as translator, vols 1-5 name no translator on their opening pages, so none is claimed for them). Volume numbers read off each title page; the years are the latest each opening page prints. The surname check takes the OCR's spellings. Added 2026-10-03: The Protector, a Vindication (Edinburgh, 1848), which names no translator. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
